# 3A Technology Solutions & 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY — Complete Reference Guide

> 3A Technology Solutions develops practical digital solutions for businesses and institutions, builds websites and landing pages, creates custom software and AI-enabled tools, and supports academic and research projects. 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY is our AI-focused educational academy.

---

## 2. Commercial Services (`/services`)

1. **Web & Digital Product Development (`/services/web-development`):** Corporate and business websites, school and institutional websites, landing pages, customer portals, web applications, online platforms, and website redesign/optimization.
2. **Custom Software Engineering (`/services/custom-software`):** Custom business applications, administrative and management systems, school management portals, payment and result management systems, digital record management systems, workflow software, and API/backend development.
3. **Artificial Intelligence & Automation (`/services/ai-automation`):** AI integration into existing business processes, AI-powered applications, AI assistants and knowledge systems, business workflow automation, document processing and extraction, AI consultation, and AI readiness assessments.
4. **Data Science & Analytics (`/services/data-science-analytics`):** Data extraction and processing, data cleaning and transformation, data visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning implementation, predictive modelling, computer vision and image analysis, and data-driven research support.
5. **Technology Consulting (`/services/technology-consulting`):** Technology advisory and professional consultation, digital transformation guidance, software and tool selection, AI adoption planning, and technical feasibility assessments.
6. **Academic Research & Project Support (`/services/academic-research-support`):** Ethical research consultation, technical mentorship, data collection/analysis, Python/ML/data science implementation, mathematical and computational modelling, project documentation/report preparation, and defence preparation for computing and mathematics-related academic projects.

---

## 3. Portfolio Structure & Case Studies (`/projects`)

### Collection 1: Business & Client Solutions
- **MarketMind AI — Akinmart Store (`/projects/marketmind-ai`):** AI-Powered Business Operations Tool developed as an internal business tool for Akinmart Store to support its supermarket operations (internal deployment confidential).
- **Dominion College School Management Portal (`/projects/dominion-college-portal`):** School Management & Digital Administration Portal supporting school fee payments, student academic result checking, and institutional administration (project link confidential).

### Collection 2: Websites & Digital Experiences
- **Raph2 Interiors — Business Website & Landing Page (`/projects/raph2-interiors`):** Public live website (`https://raph2-interior.netlify.app/`) built for Raph2 Interior Expert featuring P.O.P ceiling and interior finishing showcases, an interactive square-meter cost estimator, LocalBusiness/FAQ JSON-LD schema, and WhatsApp enquiry flows.
- **Dominion College School Management Portal (`/projects/dominion-college-portal`):** Institutional web portal case study (private institutional deployment).
- **Custom Digital Wedding Invitation & Gatepass Platform (`/projects/custom-wedding-invitation-platform`):** Custom Digital Invitation & Event Experience featuring bespoke digital invitation cards, guest gatepass functionality, and downloadable gatepasses (confidential client project).

### Collection 3: Student & Research Projects
- **Medicinal Plant Leaf Recognition (`/projects/medicinal-plant-recognition`):** Research project (`https://github.com/Psalm001/leaves-recognition`) comparing Decision Tree and CNN + Random Forest pipelines in Python and Streamlit.
- **Image Compression & Analysis — RLE vs. DCT (`/projects/image-compression-analysis`):** Student project (`https://github.com/Psalm001/image`) evaluating Run-Length Encoding and Discrete Cosine Transform compression with MSE and PSNR metrics.
- **Deforestation & Multi-Temporal Canopy Change Analysis (`/projects/deforestation-analysis`):** Research project applying computer vision to multi-temporal environmental imagery.
- **Wider Student Project Collection:** `https://github.com/psalm001`
